item.title: BaD Mindd set Journal
item.description: Choice is actively taking part in life or living deliberately, Always thinking ahead and making a plan.

item.title: Enacting Choice
item.description: A good example of me actively choosing and making a decision and working towards my main goal is when I decided that I would no longer take French so I could take 2 art classes.

item.title: My Ability to Choose
item.description: I would rate my ability with this mind set like a 7 since I know I have the ability to choose but I have issues enacting my choices or actively being present in my life.

item.title: My Goal for Choice
item.description: I intend to get better at following what I want to do instead of just what is expected of me.
